profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Newport Residences, 203 new sales, about 980 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 1,250 m; Skywaters Residences, 5 new sales, about 1,390 m; W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 1,690 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,860 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 61 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 966 new sales and 350 resales (1,316 purchases); new sales were 73.4% of these purchases. Subsales (31) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.
